source: MAFF Department of Agricultural Extension / ASPIRE Project, IFAD-funded - "បច្ចេកទេសដាំដុះក្រូចថ្លុងដែលធន់ទៅនឹងការប្រែប្រួលអាកាសធាតុ / Climate Resilience Pomelo Growing Technique", Nov 2018, 17pp
text:
As with the companion orange guide, this source ends with two blank worksheet templates for farmers to complete with their own figures: a first-year investment cost table (covering items such as planting material, planting holes, fencing, mulching material, irrigation equipment, and fertilizer) and a table for tracking annual costs and revenue from a producing orchard, including post-harvest costs like transport, storage, and packaging.

The templates contain no filled-in numbers in the source - they are provided as a planning tool for individual farmers to record their own quantities, unit costs, and expected revenue so they can judge the profitability of their own pomelo orchard.
